description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/04144/FUL: SuDS (4), hard and soft landscaping (5) and green roof (21) in respect of demolition of existing structures and redevelopment of the site, involving 14 x commercial units (Class E) at ground floor and 8 x self contained units (Class C3) over four storeys including accommodation in the roof, and associated works.
decision_conditions: Sufficient and adequate information has been submitted to be able to discharge condition number 4 (SuDS), condition number 5 (hard and soft landscaping) and condition number 21 (green roof) .  Therefore the details submitted comply with the NPPF (2024), the London Plan (2021), the Core Strategy (2010) and the Development Management Document (2014).
